kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.frostbind.desc: hold left mouse at something to freeze it in a shell of ice (once a day; then a thin beam)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.thunderclap.desc: hold left mouse bare-handed under open sky, let go to call lightning where you look
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.sunflare.desc: hold left mouse bare-handed by day, let go for a flash that burns the undead and blinds
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.stretch.desc: hold left mouse to stretch your punch
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.engulf.desc: press it on a downed or weak foe (see the gift above)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.shadowmeld.desc: vanish into the shadows for 8 seconds, quicker, and monsters forget you (45 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.tremorsense.desc: feel every creature within 24 blocks through stone: they glow for 10 seconds (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.forge_blessing.d: mend a quarter of your held tool or weapon and work with Haste II and Strength for 12 seconds (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.shield_wall.desc: plant yourself: Resistance II for 6 seconds, but slower (40 s)
a rune of absorption hearts (Absorption III) and Resistance for 15 seconds (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.mountain_leap.de: a mighty leap forward and up, and a soft landing (20 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.ender_step.desc: step up to 12 blocks the way you look, through the air (20 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.fire_breath.desc: a cone of flame ahead that sets monsters alight (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.frost_breath.des: a cone of killing cold ahead that slows and freezes monsters (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.terra_quake.desc: stamp the ground: monsters near are hurt, thrown up and slowed (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.tidal_breath.des: a full breath, a mend of 2 hearts and a dolphin's grace for 10 seconds (40 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.root_snare.desc: the ground grips every monster within 8 blocks, nearly rooting them for 4 seconds (35 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.war_cry.desc: a roar that gives you and players near Strength and Speed for 10 seconds (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.second_wind.desc: mend 3 hearts, regrow and shake off Slowness and Weakness (60 s)
a surge of Haste II, Regeneration and Luck (75 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.stroke_of_fortun: Luck III for a minute and a half, and Haste (2 min)
a long dash forward and a burst of speed (15 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.unbreakable_stan: dig in: Resistance III for 5 seconds, unmoving (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.halo_pulse.desc: a pulse of light mends you and players near, and burns the undead within 6 blocks (45 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.feral_sprint.des: Speed III and a spring in your legs for 6 seconds (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.web_snare.desc: bind what you look at (or the nearest monster) in webs: nearly rooted and weakened for 5 seconds (25 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.wind_burst.desc: beat up into the air and drift down like a feather for 8 seconds (25 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.howl.desc: a howl that gives you, players and wolves near Strength and Speed (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.pounce.desc: leap the way you look; your next blow within 2 seconds lands 50% harder (15 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.foxfire.desc: lights that draw the eyes: monsters near forget you and the nearest go blind for 3 seconds (40 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.shed_skin.desc: slough off every ill effect, mend 2 hearts and put out fire (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.grave_chill.desc: a cold from the grave: monsters within 6 blocks are slowed and weakened for 5 seconds (35 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.undying_hunger.d: for 10 seconds 30% of the harm you do comes back as health, and 1 heart now (40 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.conscript_the_de: two skeletons rise to fight for you for 30 seconds (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.spectral_phase.d: for 4 seconds nothing can touch you, and you're unseen (60 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.soul_harvest.des: tear at the monsters within 6 blocks and take their life as your own (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.verdant_bloom.de: a bloom that mends you and players near, and grows the crops round you (45 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.mirror_shift.des: trade places with what you look at, and slip away unseen for a moment (20 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.phase_shift.desc: slip out of the world for 2 seconds: untouchable, a dash forward, and a feather's fall (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.sirens_charm.des: a song: monsters within 12 blocks forget you, slow and drift to you (45 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.faerie_bargain.d: pay 2 hearts for Strength II, Speed II and Luck for 15 seconds (45 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.arcane_reflex.de: for 3 seconds blows land at a third of their force and shove the striker back (25 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.moonlit_veil.des: a veil of moonlight: unseen and quick for 8 seconds, 12 at night (40 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.blood_frenzy.des: for 10 seconds a quarter of the harm you do comes back as health, and you run faster (60 s)
